description: Posh Anarchist (ANARK) is a community-driven project built around the idea of turning bold concepts into real-world brands, products, spaces and experiences. ANARK brings together people who want to create, support and participate in projects across culture, lifestyle, hospitality, events, design and premium consumer brands. From launching independent products to developing creative spaces and experiences in places such as Greece, the community is focused on building tangible ideas with a strong identity and long-term vision. Capital. Culture. Creation.
